mapper.select: SELECT cp.property_id, p.title, p.property_type, p.trade_type, p.deposit, p.monthly_rent, p.maintenance_fee, p.area_m2, p.floor_info, b.bld_nm AS building_name, pi.image_url AS thumbnail_url FROM compare_property cp JOIN property p ON p.id = cp.property_id LEFT JOIN building b ON b.id = p.building_id LEFT JOIN property_image pi ON pi.property_id = p.id AND pi.sort_order = ( SELECT MIN(pi2.sort_order) FROM property_image pi2 WHERE pi2.property_id = p.id ) WHERE cp.user_id = #{userId} AND cp.property_status = 1 ORDER BY cp.added_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM compare_property WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND property_status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO compare_property (user_id, property_id, property_status, added_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{propertyId}, 1, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT criterion FROM preference_priority WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY priority_order
